name: audience-keeper-editor
description: Code editor bundle for Audience Keeper (CodeMirror 6). Output is committed in internal/web/static/vendor/editor.

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --metafile=meta.json --outfile=../../internal/web/static/vendor/editor/ak-editor.js && node licenses.mjs ../../internal/web/static/vendor/editor/ak-editor.js && rm meta.json
